chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) when the people of Jamal set off for Baṣrah
He said: When you march towards Baṣrah, face the Qiblah and proclaim Takbir.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali instruct the people of Jamal to do when they marched to Baṣrah?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delivered this sermon as the army of Aisha departed for Baṣrah, instructing them to face the qibla and declare God's greatness to emphasize the spiritual and ritual dimensions of their military campaign. This moment is significant in Shia historiography as it underscores the legitimacy of the conflict as a civil struggle for justice rather than mere political rivalry, with Ali framing the march as an act of worship. The emphasis on the qibla serves to unify the troops under a shared spiritual identity amidst the impending battle of Jamal.
